lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: What problem are you having today?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The Wi-Fi keeps dropping. It disconnects every twenty or thirty minutes, then comes back after about a minute.

lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: Does it happen on one device or several devices?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: It happens on both my laptop and phone. My client calls freeze, and large files stop uploading.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yesterday afternoon. It happened six times yesterday and three times this morning.

lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: What have you tried so far?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I've already tried restarting the router. First, I turned it off for thirty seconds. Then I turned it back on and waited for the lights to become steady.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: No. The problem is still happening. I also moved closer to the router and tested both devices.

lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: Thank you. The notes are helpful. I'll run a remote line test. Please don't unplug anything while it runs.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Okay. What should I try next if the test doesn't find the problem?

lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: I'll create a support ticket and arrange a technician visit rather than ask you to open the equipment.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Could you confirm the ticket number and visit window by text?

lines.speaker: Support agent
lines.text: Yes. The ticket is RV-4821, and the visit window is tomorrow from ten to noon.
